title: CIA-UAP-D020, Memorandum on Unconventional Aircraft Sightings, 1955
doc_notes: This document is a CIA memorandum summarizing a debriefing of four individuals, including Senator Richard Russell, regarding a 1955 UAP sighting in the Soviet Union.

incidents.summary: A group of four individuals, including U.S. Senator Richard Russell, observed a luminescent greenish-yellow object while traveling by train in the Soviet Union.
incidents.explanation: Probably steep climbing aircraft or missiles.
